title: 承認・レビュー状態がCompaction・再起動・Fork・権限変更・Dispatchと同期せず、失効すべき承認が残るか有効な承認が消える
summary: Cross-provider cluster of fixes (2026-08-29 → 2026-09-03) showing that agent approval/review state is not kept consistent with session lifecycle events, failing both open and closed. Fail-open: Codex CLI 0.151.0 (2026-08-29) 'Prevented stale Guardian classifications from authorizing actions after permission [changes]' — a cached approval classification kept authorizing actions after the permission profile changed; Claude Code v2.1.257 'Fixed sessions dispatched from agent view overriding target directory's permission mode' — dispatch context carried the wrong permission mode into a target directory. Fail-closed/lost state: Codex 0.153.0 (2026-09-03) 'Guardian review history survives compaction, restarts, and user-created forks' — review history was previously lost on compaction, restart, and fork; Codex 0.152.0 (2026-09-01) 'Automatic approval reviews preserve user instructions, answers, and valid [context]' — automated reviews dropped the user's instructions and prior answers; Claude Code v2.1.258 'Fixed remote/scheduled sessions failing after re-sent permission approval couldn't be applied'. Mechanism: approval decisions are stored as session-local ephemeral state with no invalidation/persistence contract tied to permission-profile changes, context compaction, restarts, forks, or cross-context dispatch — so security review either re-authorizes stale decisions or silently loses valid ones, and users cannot tell which regime they are in.

evidence.title: Codex CLI 0.151.0 / 0.152.0 / 0.152.1 / 0.153.0
evidence.summary: Stale Guardian classifications authorizing actions after permission changes (0.151.0); automatic approval reviews dropping user instructions/answers (0.152.0); Guardian review history not surviving compaction/restarts/forks (0.153.0).
